authorization_quote: Em JAGS, as cadeias precisam ser bem grandes. Em Stan 2k pode ser efetivo, mas Jags precisa ser algo como 20k. Rode com 20k. Em paralelo, veja se d<c3><a1> para adaptar pra Stan e como fica rodando 2k cadeias.
purpose: New authorized A/D JAGS20k experiment and same-target D Stan2k comparison; old pilot and its verdict preserved

case.unit: precinct in the authors' D.C. 2010 data
data_validation: identical data and order in both models
six all-one n by 1 design matrices for A
asymmetric A/W interface sentinel and swapped negative control

A.model: literal qbl, not a certified physical generator
A.runner: direct rjags data route, not the original one-chain adaptive vignette workflow
known_limitations: F1: some positive-prior parent states imply invalid pW
a failed run is retained, not retried until a desired result

D.model: experimental multinomial transfer mixture with section-level hierarchy
D.predictor: eta[i,b]=alpha[b]+b0[b]+sqrt(v[b])*z[i,b], z standard Normal; centered JAGS expression h[i,b]~Normal(alpha[b],precision=1/v[b]), eta=h+b0 is equivalent

priors.b0: independent Normal(mean=0,variance=0.0001); do not merge with alpha
priors.v: independent Exponential(rate=5), on variance, not SD
priors.partial_order: pi1>=max(pi2,pi3); no order between pi2 and pi3

D.class: one Z[i]~Categorical(pi), shared by all three count categories
D.identification: conditional per-section probabilities can be matched by m=s=0 using tau0=1-pA,nu0=pW/(1-pA); identification requires across-section restrictions and is not established here

paired_design.engine: Stan D; common augmented-posterior diagnostic view only
paired_design.geography: intercept-only, full six observation-specific effects, no geographic predictors
paired_design.RNG_name: Stan base seed plus distinct chain IDs; not JAGS RNG-equivalent

initialization.class: Z marginalized and reconstructed conditionally per draw, not initialized
initialization.magnitude_alphas: all four equal the chain-specific value [-1,0,1,-0.5]
initialization.A_auxiliary_counts: floor(N*mu) using the respective incremental k*logistic or extreme k+(1-k)*logistic transform, with original endpoint transformation untouched

paired_design.timing: One four-chain rjags object; A then D and diagnostics sequential; avoid compilation/other sampling during measured processes. Record overlap if accidental; no automatic resampling.
paired_design.failures: save error/warnings/stage/inputs/seed/log; no changed model, dropped chain, replacement seed, data exclusion, retry or extension; other independent tasks can finish
paired_design.execution: 4 serial Stan chains; compatibility view does not run a JAGS engine

monitoring.draw_shape: iterations by chains by variables, with chain identity retained

primary_common_outputs: pi[1:3] posterior means/SD/quantiles and per-chain means
expected-vote functionals M=sum_i N_i*(1-tau_i)*m_i and S=sum_i N_i*tau_i*(1-nu_i)*s_i within each joint draw
M/N_total and S/N_total with N_total explicit
posterior class probabilities per precinct and descriptive classification differences
timings and ESS per second where ESS is defined
comparison.m_s_mapping: A uses its realized auxiliary count fractions and literal .999 manufactured endpoint; D uses continuous logistic magnitudes. These are analogous model functionals, not identical latent quantities or observed ballot counts
comparison.classes: retain Z for joint totals; empirical class probabilities and modal labels are descriptive. Preserve ties without assigning one class silently
comparison.D_ballot_counts_secondary: given the same posterior Z and parameter draw, (L0,M_count,S_count)|W~Multinomial(W; tau*nu/pW,(1-tau)*m/pW,tau*(1-nu)*s/pW). Summarize separately from expected-vote functionals; exact degenerate W=0,pW=0 yields all zero
comparison.difference_interpretation: sensitivity to jointly changed likelihood and latent-magnitude construction, not sampler equivalence and not isolated causal contribution of one modification

new_round.historical: Compare old2k vs new20k descriptively; fresh run with same starting seeds/inits is not an independent replication and no prefix equivalence is presumed
new_round.D_engine: Same target not asserted by mean agreement: independent density/Jacobian/likelihood checks required first
new_round.MCSE: For the 23 common globals report difference and sqrt(MCSE_JAGS^2+MCSE_Stan^2), plus absolute standardized difference; no equivalence claim unless both relevant precision checks pass. No posthoc tolerance or new posterior acceptance test.
new_round.group_status: Report global continuous, local, discrete and sampler groups separately as diagnostics; all-target verdict still requires all mandatory targets. No waiver for rare classes or added GQ randomness.

diagnostics.undefined_statistic: report NA and reason; not a pass. Analytically constant quantities are separate, not waived merely because sampled values were constant
diagnostics.discrete: Mandatory targets and thresholds are fixed in decision_table. Z itself is categorical; assess each 0/1 class indicator, not only its numeric label.
diagnostics.adaptation: report end.adaptation result and warnings; inadequate adaptation precludes a reliable-comparison verdict
diagnostics.verdict: exploratory-comparison-only requires both complete runs, adequate adaptation and every mandatory row in decision_table passing. Any failed, unavailable or missing mandatory statistic yields computationally_inconclusive; all outputs remain descriptive with their failed precision checks. Neither verdict validates A, identification, G10 or production.

decision_table.targets: 23 global continuous targets: pi[1:3], six alpha, six v, six b0, M_total, S_total
All 6*n continuous mu means; active observation probabilities pA,pW for A and pA,pW,pO for D
3*n indicators I(Z_i=c), all three classes for every precinct; additionally 3 draw-level class counts sum_i I(Z_i=c)
statistics: max per-chain mean minus min per-chain mean

thresholds.range_scale: indicators on [0,1]; class counts divided by n for the range check only

decision_table.on_undefined_or_failure: computationally_inconclusive; sample-only constant or rare indicator with undefined mandatory diagnostics is not an analytically known zero
decision_table.justification: 5 percentage points is a prospective operational chain-disagreement ceiling for this exploratory pilot, not a fraud detection cutoff, posterior equality test or precision guarantee

decision_table.targets: All 4*n auxiliary Binomial(N,mu) count nodes of A
Secondary conditional D ballot-count reconstruction, expected-count conditional means, expected-vote functionals divided by N_total
decision_table.on_undefined_or_failure: Do not certify precision; a support or algebraic identity failure is an implementation defect and blocks results. Added reconstruction randomness cannot rescue diagnostics of the primary joint posterior.

diagnostics.compatibility_scope: The shared processor checks common augmented-posterior draws. HMC divergences/depth/energy and all z/r precision also must pass independently; GQ randomness cannot rescue the underlying sampler.

preflight_tests.grid: N=1..4, tau/nu/m/s each in {0,0.2,0.7,1}; include .999 and asymmetric example tau=.6,nu=.4,m=.2,s=.3
checks: sequential Binomial factorization and zero-turnout boundary
full conditional transfer-count distribution including covariance
three-class mixture versus explicit class summation
JAGS D probabilities on fixed deterministic parents agree with R
ordered pi prior and Exp(5) variance plus alpha/b0 audit against A
asymmetric actual data interface and wrong-input negative control
chain-array shape and synthetic between-chain separation detected
no clamp, hidden renormalization or data exclusion

Decision fixtures: finite class-occupancy discrepancy >0.05 is inconclusive even if other metrics pass; required NA is inconclusive; sample-only constant is inconclusive; independently certified analytic constant is labelled exact_not_MC only when explicitly declared, and no empirical pilot exemptions exist.

checkpoints: Independent delta review of JAGS copies and new protocol before JAGS sampling
Independent D/Stan target and executable review before Stan sampling
Independent quantitative result review before final comparative claims
preservation: new paths only for fits, logs, tests and rounds; no deletion or overwriting previous attempts; preserve failures and all consumed inputs/code/configuration in manifests
later_work: author-output search or different complete external replication target
identification/sensitivity simulation in G4 after requisite approvals
Brasilia 2022 common-input comparison after appropriate gates
national scaling and inference remain separate

supersedes.reason: New explicit user authorization; prior pilot remains immutable, not retrospectively extended or reclassified

stan_design.parametrization: Noncentered h=alpha+sqrt(v)*z; z~N(0,1); v~Exp(5) on VARIANCE; b0 and alpha kept separate
stan_design.pi: r2,r3 iid Uniform(0,1); pi=(1,r2,r3)/(1+r2+r3). Integrate nuisance u1 exactly; Jacobian u1^2 cancels conditional-uniform density 1/u1^2
stan_design.likelihood: Sum all 3 class-weighted multinomial masses by log_sum_exp per precinct; no clamp or approximate A substitution
stan_design.output: Conditional class probabilities and categorical Z reconstruction per draw; joint M/S and active pA/pW/pO from the SAME Z, plus Rao-Blackwell summaries separately
stan_design.initialization: Map the previous four initial values: alpha/b0/v identical, z=0, r2=.25,r3=.125; no claim seeds match JAGS RNG

runtime_diagnostics.internal_NCP_parameters: All z and r parameters require rank Rhat<1.01, bulk/tail ESS>=400. Common augmented targets retain prior thresholds; NAs never pass.
